recommendations.title: Harden dashboard CTA + readiness fallbacks
problem_evidence:
4/6 recent runs mention CTA/readiness timeout

recommendations.proposed_change: Add fallback selectors and state probes for Story Mode entry; if unavailable, surface alternate next action without run failure.
recommendations.implementation_prompt: Update synthetic runner + dashboard UI to use resilient CTA matching, retry with progressive waits, and non-fatal fallback when Story Mode is temporarily unavailable.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce automation failures and improve consistency of generated student posts.

recommendations.proposed_change: Capture failure class, failed step, selector/url, and screenshot path in report JSON.
recommendations.implementation_prompt: Extend report schema with telemetry fields (failureClass, failedStep, selector, screenshotPath, attemptCount) and persist screenshot on failure for rapid diagnosis.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster root-cause detection and fewer repeated regressions.

recommendations.title: Improve low-performance recovery path in dashboard
recommendations.proposed_change: When learner momentum is low, bias Self Study picks toward short-win modules and show one-click recovery mission.
recommendations.implementation_prompt: Add a momentum-aware branch in Dashboard next actions and Self Study ranking that prioritizes easier high-success modules after low-score sessions.
recommendations.expected_impact: Higher completion rates and better synthetic/user sentiment.
